content: They walked our Bhiwandi facility for two days before quoting anything, and the layout they came back with moved 18% more pallets through the same floor than the one we were running. Installation finished inside our peak-season shutdown.

They walked our Bhiwandi facility for two days before quoting anything, and the layout they came back with moved 18% more pallets through the same floor than the one we were running. Installation finished inside our peak-season shutdown.

The mezzanine came in ahead of schedule and the anchor work was properly certified, which matters when a plant audit is six weeks away. Their engineers stayed on site until our own team was comfortable running it.

We needed selective racking that could take a 1500 kg pallet at beam level without creeping. Two years on there is no deflection, and the frame geometry has made picking noticeably faster than our old cantilever setup.
What I valued most was that they told us which of our ideas would not work before we spent money on them. The archive and carton-flow area is the smoothest part of our operation now.

Four hundred and eighty racks delivered and erected in nineteen days, with a supervisor on site the whole time who answered his phone. That is not the experience we had with our previous two suppliers.
We came to them for racking and stayed for the training. They spent a full day with our operators on safe stacking heights and load labels, and that alone cut our near-miss reports to almost nothing.
